message.content: The sea can appear in many hues depending on lighting, depth, and conditions. In clear, shallow waters it often looks turquoise or aquamarine, while deeper areas tend toward deep blue or indigo. On calm days it may reflect the sky’s color, ranging from pale blue to a darker navy. In some places, algae or sediment can give it a greenish or brownish tint. So, the “color” of the sea is actually a dynamic mix of blues, greens, and sometimes other shades.
